name: Primara the Unicorn
description: Primara is a magnificent, celestial unicorn possessing a coat of purest white, silver-shimmering hooves, and a spiral horn that radiates a soft, golden luminescence. Wise, gentle, and fiercely protective of the untamed natural world, she serves as a guardian of sacred groves, fey crossings, and pure springs, offering aid to those pure of heart while striking down corrupt intruders with righteous fury.
ideals: Purity: 'The woods and waters must remain undefiled by the greed and malice of mortals.'
Protection: 'Those who honor the balance of nature shall find shelter under our boughs; those who exploit it shall face our wrath.'
bonds: The sacred forest groves and hidden fey sanctuaries she protects.
Silvanon, Mielikki, and the divine powers of the wild.
flaws: Unforgiving toward those who willfully despoil nature or break sacred oaths.
speech_patterns: Telepathic, resonant, and melodic, echoing with the sound of rustling leaves and flowing streams, carrying deep wisdom and profound calm.
mannerisms: Treads silently across mossy ground without leaving tracks, dips her glowing horn into waters to purify them, and watches travelers with deep, intelligent eyes that pierce through deception.
motivations: To guard her sacred domain against aberrant corruption, fiendish incursions, and destructive logging or poaching.
knowledge: Deep intuitive awareness of woodland paths, fey crossings, magical flora and fauna, and hidden curses or blights affecting the land.
gm_notes: Primara serves as a legendary celestial ally or guardian encounter for characters venturing into deep wilderness or fey-touched realms. She can offer healing, prophecy, or divine quests to worthy adventurers while testing their character and purity of intent.
